notes.title: Update 1.03! Rebalancing!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, adventurers of Elonia![/p][p]A small rebalancing update. ^^[/p][p]What’s new:[/p][list][*][p]\[General] Increased gold and influence gains at the end of each chapter,[/p][/*][*][p]\[Necromancer Faction] Increased healing gain (from +2 to +3) and defense (from +2 to +3) for the ,[/p][/*][*][p]\[Necromancer Faction] Undead now have a "lifespan." After 3 game turns, a summoned undead is automatically recalled.[/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy! ^^[/p]

notes.title: Update v1.02! New language added!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, adventurers of Elonia![/p][p][/p][p]Great news, the game is now available in German![/p][p]Note: please start a campaign from the beginning to fully apply the language change.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy! ^^[/p]
